intro:
You keep the decision record of a data retention project. Decisions and their reasons change, the user sets and lifts constraints, and open questions get answers or stay open.

Initial specification:
- [e001] After the trial results, Lars wrote in the decision log that the decision on the pseudonym hash is `hmac-sha256`.
- [e002] The architecture review approved `amundsen-oss` as the decision on the data catalog, as Hana noted in the minutes.
- [e003] In the design meeting, the group chose `jsonl-gz`, and Jun recorded it as the decision on the export format.
- [e004] In the design meeting, the group chose `presidio-lib`, and Femi recorded it as the decision on the masking library.
- [e005] The architecture review approved `airflow-dag` as the decision on the purge scheduler, as Ana noted in the minutes.
- [e006] After the trial results, Mei wrote in the decision log that the decision on the retention period in days is `30`.
- [e007] The minutes by Tove give the motive of the choice, so the reason for the decision on the pseudonym hash is `why-storage-cost`.
- [e008] Lars recorded why the group chose it, and the reason for the decision on the data catalog is `why-gdpr`.
- [e009] Sami recorded why the group chose it, and the reason for the decision on the export format is `why-ops-load`.
- [e010] The minutes by Femi give the motive of the choice, so the reason for the decision on the masking library is `why-storage-cost`.
- [e011] After a message from the user, Oona recorded that the status of the constraint cn-no-new-vendors is `in-force`.
- [e012] After a message from the user, Uma recorded that the status of the constraint cn-eu-data-only is `in-force`.
- [e013] Nils wrote in the ticket that the answer to the open question oq-audit-sink is `still-open`.
- [e014] Uma wrote in the ticket that the answer to the open question oq-legal-hold is `still-open`.
- [e015] Kira brought the question to the meeting, and the answer to the open question oq-restore-sla is `still-open` for now.
- [e016] In the review, Yara recorded that the answer to the open question oq-delete-owner is `still-open`.
- [e017] Dara wrote in the ticket that the answer to the open question oq-test-data is `still-open`.

Rules for this task:
- A value changes only by an event that decides, answers, corrects, assigns, links or reviews it. A proposal with no decision, a withdrawn draft, a question, a link to a page and an archived copy change nothing.
- A correction or a new entry replaces the earlier value. The earlier value is then superseded.
- The initial specification gives the first value of each item.
- A question about the values of an item "at some point" counts every value from the initial specification on, up to the time of the question. The value "directly before" the current value is the value that the current value replaced.
- Some decisions have a recorded reason. The closed list of reason ids is `why-gdpr`, `why-storage-cost`, `why-restore-speed`, `why-audit-trail`, `why-vendor-risk`, `why-ops-load`.
- Each decision with a recorded reason has one reason at a time. An entry that records a reason for it replaces the earlier reason. A later entry can replace the reason and keep the decision. A new decision with no such entry keeps the earlier reason.
- The user sets constraints and can lift them later. A constraint is `in-force` or `lifted`.
- An open question has the answer `still-open` until an entry answers it. A later entry can replace an answer.
Every event has a label of the form [eNNN] with a three-digit number. A higher number is later in time. A later event can change or cancel an earlier one.
Some material quotes old pages or copies for history. A quote of that kind is not a new statement.
